root_causes.description: The game loads the root loose hud_leaderboard2_1_6.bgui, shadowing the IGPHASEHUD.bff entry changed by v34-v40 candidates.
The active right-anchored time control ends 3 logical px beyond the visible row edge, and the active digit raster extends another 2 logical px beyond advance.

state_variance_disposition.apparent_variance_reason: The rightmost numeral changes over time and has a different visible stroke shape at the same fixed cut boundary.

invalidated_candidates.reason: They targeted a BFF entry hidden by the active root loose BGUI; no runtime effect can be attributed to those edits.

recommended_minimal_candidate.target: root and GUI direct loose hud_leaderboard2_1_6.bgui payloads
recommended_minimal_candidate.object: Group A SplitApplink x field only
